decisions: The shared API client owns bearer/cookie transport, CSRF, request IDs, bounded safe retries and owner refresh single-flight. Tenant and guest cache keys include principal scope. Selection and editor state machines preserve frozen snapshot semantics and reject stale preview revisions.

The Expo app now has real OTP login, workspace picker/create, project list/create, project collections, derivative-only thumb640 grid, web/native multipart import, style/version/training flows, apply wizard, integrity-bound review decisions, draft JSON editing, export presets/jobs, profile/member/quota/retention settings and run progress/cancel/retry vertical slices backed by exact server DTOs. UploadQueue persists only nonsecret metadata, hashes files incrementally, limits concurrency to two files and two parts, refreshes signed URLs per batch, resumes only an exact name/size/mtime/SHA match and completes with ordered ETags. Media loading is bounded and never falls back to a master. Run polling stops on an authoritative terminal state and links an output collection when present. Web/native auth sends the correct challenge_id/client_type, X-Photo-Client and session CSRF/refresh envelope. Native refresh/CSRF secrets persist only in Expo SecureStore; access tokens remain memory-only. Web restores through the HttpOnly refresh cookie after CSRF bootstrap.

Expo was upgraded to SDK 57.0.24 with React Native 0.86.3, React types 19.2 and expo-router 57.0.22. TypeScript, tests and web export pass with a consistent dependency tree; production audit has zero high/critical advisories. The pinned Darwin ARM64 Rolldown dev binding is retained because npm fails to install that optional dependency and Vitest otherwise cannot start; it is not a production dependency.

The photographer editor now has real preview, prompt-mask, explicit seeded generation and identity SaveEdits owner flows. It consumes only canonical fenced outputs through short-lived signed URLs; mask references are source-bound and persisted in the draft revision. Rich canvas strokes, multi-point visual picking and defect proposal artifact presentation remain UI work, so P15 stays in_progress.

The photographer editor now provides visual multi-point MobileSAM prompting on the rendered image, including positive/negative modes, bounded normalization, overlay feedback, undo and clear. Freehand raster strokes and defect proposal artifact presentation remain UI work, so P15 stays in_progress.

The photographer editor now supports bounded freehand add/subtract/protect strokes through the existing immutable mask.rasterize workflow. Target and protected masks are persisted in the draft and protected masks are supplied to generation. Defect proposal artifact presentation remains UI work, so P15 stays in_progress.

Review detail no longer claims candidate artifacts are unavailable: it presents canonical signed run outputs, including image candidates and defect/report artifacts, while decision submission remains revision/hash bound. P15 remains in_progress because the complete typed tool-panel and EditorStore behavior specified in document 10 still requires implementation.

The editor now uses a typed immutable EditorStore for recipe history and exact preview fencing. Older preview results cannot replace the current source/draft state. Full typed tool panels, pan/zoom viewport and native device E2E remain P15 work.

Typed editor panels now construct bounded OverrideV1 module data and use operation capability reasons. Extended modules remain fail-closed until the corresponding Apply v4 state-machine migration is approved and installed; only the currently executed strength control is active.

Mask coordinates now pass through a tested inverse viewport transform and are stored in normalized oriented source space. The editor exposes distinct approximate proxy and explicit 100% preview requests; completed previews still require exact source SHA, draft revision and request revision.

MaskCanvas now applies the tested viewport transform visually. Gesture coordinates are collected by the untransformed outer canvas, then inverted into oriented source space, keeping prompt and freehand masks stable under 1x-16x zoom and pan.

MaskCanvas now supports prompt points, freehand strokes and explicit polygons on web/native code paths. Polygon completion is explicit, invalid contours remain local, and only bounded finalized shapes reach mask.rasterize.

CompareCanvas presents the source preview1600 derivative beside the current rendered candidate. The master remains inaccessible to the client; masks can be authored against the source derivative before any preview task completes.

Editor effect panels now expose the complete typed Beauty, Defects, Geometry and Restoration contracts, including ordered defect diameter bounds, all body warp controls, denoise strength, 2x/4x upscale and dust policy. Extended mutations remain disabled until Apply v4 so the UI cannot persist controls that the current Apply graph ignores.

SaveEdits no longer plans only from the identity style. Admission and workflow independently derive the same canonical effective style from the persisted source-bound override; qualified runtime locks are selected before run creation. The UI enables only branches now present in Apply v4 and keeps unsupported branches read-only.
